cards.body_en: Diarrhea is passing loose stools three or more times in a day.
Check skin pinch, thirst, and sunken eyes to classify dehydration.
Acute watery diarrhea and dysentery require different management.

cards.title_en: When to Refer a Diarrhea Patient to Hospital
cards.body_en: Refer immediately for blood in stool or inability to drink.
Prevention includes hand washing, safe water, ORS use, and sanitation.
